name: Suzuki RM250 (two-stroke)
intro: Suzuki's 250 two-stroke motocross bike. Premix, a top end that wears and no lights.

add.title: Check compression and the top end
add.instructions: Do a compression test. Low numbers mean the piston and rings are due. Clean the power valve while you are in there.
add.reason: A tired top end and a gummed power valve are the most common problems on a used two-stroke.

B: It runs on premix. Mix the oil into the fuel at the ratio in the manual. There is no oil tank.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
